thread:
maya: Heads-up finance — Reseller Veridian's invoice INV-2026-04-17 appears to have the same promo applied twice, total overcredit $10,000. Need manual reversal/debit memo and GL guidance.
billing-bot: Alert: Invoice INV-2026-04-17 flagged by rule dup_promo_v1 — duplicate discount lines detected.
omar: can you paste the invoice lines + promo ids so I can verify?
maya: sure, here's the snippet from billing export:```
INV-2026-04-17 | Veridian | LineItem: USAGE-GPU | 1000.00 | qty 10
INV-2026-04-17 | Veridian | Promo: PROMO-RED-20 | -5000.00 | promo_id:PROMO-RED-20
INV-2026-04-17 | Veridian | Promo: PROMO-RED-20 | -5000.00 | promo_id:PROMO-RED-20  <-- duplicate
Total due: 0.00 (should be 10,000.00)
```
li: ok that looks like a double-apply of the same promo id. This is a promo reversal, not a goodwill. We should route as contra-revenue / promo reversal so it doesn't hit COGS.
kevin: GL wise we usually post promo reversals to contra-revenue. Proposed: Debit 4-2106 (Promo Contra) $10,000; Credit 1-1100 (AR) $10,000. @li confirm?
li: confirm. Also need the reseller sign-off for a debit memo because they accepted the promos in their invoices to end customers.
maya: Veridian already emailed back: "We approve reversal on our partner account — accidental stacking from our promo engine". I'll attach that in the memo.
sarah-finance: provisional approval from finance to create a credit reversal up to $10,000 pending signed debit memo. I'll draft the memo and route for signatures.
omar: who needs to sign? partner lead + partnerships director + finance? policy says partner sign + partnerships for <25k. CFO only if >25k.
sarah-finance: correct. I'll route to Partnerships for signature and Legal for a quick check on wording.
maya: I'll send the signed doc once I have it today and cc accounting.
kevin: posting instructions for journal when memo signed: "DEBIT 4-2106 Promo Contra $10,000 / CREDIT 1-1100 AR $10,000". Memo text: "duplicate promo PROMO-RED-20 on INV-2026-04-17".
billing-bot: Action logged: provisional_credit_created id CR-98765 amount 10000 status:pending_memo_sign.
li: once memo is attached I'll prepare the reversal entry in NetSuite and tag transaction with partner code VER-001.
omar: please also attach the original invoice and the email approval to the journal for audit.
maya: will do. thanks all :pray:
kevin: thanks — keep me posted if anything changes :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Note: rule dup_promo_v1 auto-suppressed customer notification to avoid customer confusion. Admins can re-enable notifications if needed.
maya: closing thread on my side after memo submitted.
